name: D'lite choco-chip oat cookies
ingredients_raw: Oats Flour & Flakes (25%), Sweetener (INS 965 (i), INS 960), Wheat flour, Bakery Shortening (Vegetable fat - Palm /Palmolein oil and palm kernel oil based),Sugar Free Dark Chocolate Chips (12%) [Sweetener (INS 965), Edible Vegetable Fat (Hydrogenated)- Palm, Cocoa solids & Emulsifiers (INS492,INS322(i) - Lecithin of Soya Origin)], Butter, Milk Solids (Skimmed Milk Powder), Fructo oligosaccharides (3%), Cocoa powder, salt, Raising agents (INS 500(ii),INS 503(ii)), Emulsifiers (INS 322(i), INS 472e), CONTAINS ADDED NATURE IDENTICAL AND ARTIFICIAL VANILLA FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES.
